label: Waiver claims reconcile themselves with MFL after every run — no "Reload from MFL". Run times now follow the league's Thu/Fri/Sat/Sun 9:00 AM ET schedule (MFL's calendar export omits in-season runs). After a run, claims and withdrawals MFL already processed clear on the Market badge, Home tile and Claims screen; any unsent bid or change that doesn't match MFL is kept.
